items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ken Burns covered that but he didn't go into depth.

ctx.x: Would you say that they did a complete story on jazz? They didn't go far back enough I thought. Nothing was mentioned about the Lafayette.
